Rendering and Wall Insulation in Brynmawr

About Us

Thirty-Five Years On The Tools

George started out skimming ceilings and boarding out extensions, and 15 years later, the van still goes out every morning with him in it.

He's now joined by his partner Gareth, who brings 20 years of experience in the trade. Together, they run a small, local outfit built on quality workmanship, reliability and pride in what they do.

When you ring 4 Seasons Rendering & Plastering, you get the people who will actually be on your scaffold, not a call centre and not a salesman on commission.

With 35 years of combined experience, we specialise in rendering, external wall insulation and plastering, delivering quality finishes with a personal service from start to finish.

Every job starts with a free site survey. We come out, look at the walls properly, and price the work from what is actually there.

Why Choose 4 Seasons

  • Free site survey on every quoteWe measure up in person, because solid wall, cavity and tired old dash all price differently once you get close.
  • See your house before we startWe send you a virtual image of your own property in the colour you are considering, so you are not choosing off a sample card.
  • Ten and fifteen year guaranteesTen years on the render, fifteen on the external wall insulation.
  • Qualified and system approvedCity and Guilds Level 3 plastering, and approved installers for SPS EnviroWall and Wetherby.
What We Do

Our Services

Outside work is the bulk of what we do, and the inside trade we started in is still on the books. All of it goes on all year round.

External Wall Insulation

Solid walls insulated from the outside and finished in the render you choose.

Silicone Rendering

Machine sprayed silicone render, flexible, breathable and low maintenance.

Plastering and Plasterboarding

Skimming, boarding and full room work inside the house.

Coloured Render

Through coloured render in your shade, so there is no painting to keep up.

Pebble Dashing

Traditional dash finish, patched to match or applied fresh.

Monocouche Render

One coat through coloured render, scraped back to a clean even face.

Common Questions

FAQ

Yes. That is the single biggest thing people get wrong about rendering. The old sand and cement renders needed warm dry weather to go off properly, so the trade got a reputation for stopping in October. The silicone and monocouche systems we use are designed to be applied in cold conditions, and we work through the winter with them. We keep an eye on the forecast and we will not spray into driving rain or a hard frost, but a cold week in January is not a reason to put your job back to spring.

Nothing. We come out, survey the property, measure up and price the work properly. We would rather stand on your drive and see the walls than guess at a number over the phone, because solid wall, cavity, pebble dash and old render all behave differently once you get close to them.

Yes, and we think it is the most useful thing we do. When we come out for the survey we take photographs, and we send you back a virtual image of your own property finished in the colour you are thinking about. Picking a render colour off a small sample card is hard. Seeing it on your own house is not.

Ten years on the render and fifteen years on the external wall insulation. Those are the system guarantees that come with working to the manufacturer specification rather than cutting corners on the build up.

George holds City and Guilds Level 3 in plastering, and we are approved installers for SPS EnviroWall and Wetherby systems. That approval matters on insulation work, because the guarantee depends on the whole system going on the way the manufacturer designed it.

A straightforward render on a three bed semi is usually a week, weather allowing. External wall insulation takes longer because the boards, beads and mesh coat all go on before the finish, so think closer to two weeks. We will give you a realistic run of days when we quote, not a best case one.

We do. Plastering and plasterboarding is where George started and we still take it on, from a single ceiling skim to boarding out a whole extension.

We are based in Brynmawr and we work right across Gwent, from Ebbw Vale and Abergavenny in the north down to Cwmbran and Newport in the south. If you are not sure whether you are in range, ring and ask.
